title: Provident fund administrative and inspection charges
description: The administrative charges an employer pays with the provident fund contributions, and the inspection charges that an establishment exempted under section 143 of the Code on Social Security, 2020 pays in their place, each a per cent of the pay or wages with its least sum, in its notification's words. S.O. 2011(E) fixes the administrative charges from 1 June 2018 under the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952; from 29 June 2026 it is held as continued by section 164(2)(a) of the Code under paragraphs 28(2) and 29(1) of the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, under which no other percentage was found. S.O. 2701(E) of 29 May 2026, its rate corrected by S.O. 4602(E), fixes the inspection charges for exemptions from the Schemes of 1952 and 1976, read from 29 June 2026 as their successors of 2026. The inspection charges before 29 May 2026 and the Insurance Fund's administrative charges were not read in their instruments.

cells.name: Administrative charges of an establishment other than a non-functional one with no contributory member
cells.wording: S.O. 2011(E): … the Central Government, after consulting the Central Board and having regard to the resources of the Employees' Provident Fund available for meeting its normal administrative expenses, hereby fixes the administrative charges payable by the employer for the purposes of paragraph 30 and sub-paragraph (1) of paragraph 38 of the said Scheme with effect from 1st June, 2018 at 0.50 per cent (zero point five zero per cent.) of the pay as referred to in the said paragraphs subject to a minimum sum of seventy-five rupees per month for every non-functional establishment having no contributory member and five hundred rupees per month per establishment for other establishments.

cells.name: Inspection charges of an establishment exempted from the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme
cells.wording: S.O. 2701(E): … the Central Government hereby directs that the employers in relation to an establishment or class of establishments or any person or class of persons exempted under section 143 of the said Code from the provisions of the scheme specified in column (2) of the Table below to pay inspection charges at the rate specified in column (3) for the time being payable to the employees of the establishment or receivable by the persons or class of persons, as the case may be, in respect of which contributions, would have been payable but for such exemption, subject to the minimum amount specified in column (4) to the administration account mentioned in column (5) of the said Table, within fifteen days of the close of every month. [Table, Sl. No. (i)] Exempted from: Employees' Provident Fund Scheme, 1952. Rate of Inspection charges (per cent. of wages): 0.18. Minimum Inspection Charge (in Rupees): 8750. Payable to: Provident Fund Administration Account.
